_comment: Model identities per role. Each role carries its own status, and a run
refuses to use a role that is not 'confirmed' — so the secondary judge and
the type classifier can be decided independently of the primary.
Rationale on standalone merits: open weights with per-token logit access
(required for the single-token readout), mid scale so a 130-step trajectory
fits the prefix budget on available hardware, and cheap enough to run every
The declared family is checked against the resolver, not trusted: a
mislabelled family would silently defeat the disjointness constraints.
The type classifier must be disjoint from BOTH judge families, because
typing conditions the evidence policy either judge reads.
